fields.name: default_probation_days
fields.label: %default_probation_days%
fields.help: New hires without a probation end get one this many days after they join; 0 means none.

fields.name: default_notice_days
fields.label: %default_notice_days%
fields.help: Notice period given to a new hire who has none set.

fields.name: retirement_age
fields.label: %retirement_age%
fields.help: Used by reports and alerts; 0 means not set.

fields.name: probation_alert_days
fields.label: %probation_alert_days%
fields.help: How many days ahead probation endings are flagged.

fields.name: pay_mode
fields.label: %pay_mode%
fields.help: Where a person's base wage comes from: entered for each person, set by their position, or the position's wage with a per-person override.

fields.name: manager_rank_rule
fields.label: %manager_rank_rule%
fields.help: Whether a manager must rank strictly above the people who report to them, or may rank equal. Ranks come from grades. The rule is not checked when either person's rank cannot be worked out (no grade on their terms, position or job), and an HR manager can set it aside with a reason.

fields.name: minimum_working_age
fields.label: %minimum_working_age%
fields.help: The youngest age at which a person may be hired, on the day they join.
